newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies 11 municipal issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies 11 municipal issues for insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said it has qualified for bond insurance the following 11 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Kirkwood Community College, Iowa, $5.140 million project (tax) bonds and $4.305 million (AMT) project bonds.
--St. Cloud, Minn., $17.6 million GO hyrdro revenue refunding bonds.
--Nevada Univ. and Comm., Nev., $15.180 million revenue refunding bonds.
--Carthage CSD, N.Y., $3.404 million school district bonds.
--Chittenango CSD, N.Y., $7.670 million school district bonds.
--Fort Bend Cty MUD #68, Texas, $2.230 million tax bonds.
